title: Every class with code in the tester reaches the diagnostic mixin
intention: Every class with code in the tester (Seal, Isolation and NoIsolation in cairn/devices/tester/isolation.py) reaches DiagnosticBase, so the every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin sieve reads the tester green and any of them can run a diagnostic report when we get stuck.
why: Measured 2026-10-30: inspector.every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin({'component': 'tester', 'dir': 'cairn/devices/tester'}, Path('cairn/devices/tester')) names three findings, cairn/devices/tester/isolation.py:137 Seal, :636 Isolation and :717 NoIsolation, and the tester's build gate carries that red at every PROVEME crossing. Akien 2026-10-27, recorded on 339a45cee6a1: 'everybody must inherit it. that's why it's a mixin' / 'any class with code it in should be able to run a diagnostic report when we need it.'
traces_to: Law 4 (the rule is enforced by the sieve, and the tester is red under it); Law 9 (the tester's build gate is red until this lands). RULE 1: the tester imports base, a tool, through its public module cairn.tools.base.diagnostic, as it already imports cairn.tools.base.address.
how: Add DiagnosticBase as the first base of Seal (kept @dataclass(frozen=True)) and of Isolation (ahead of ABC), importing it from cairn.tools.base.diagnostic in cairn/devices/tester/isolation.py (D1); NoIsolation reaches it through Isolation and is not edited. Prove it with cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_every_tester_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py (D2).
falsifier: Falsifier: Done when cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_every_tester_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py, under PROVES for 668c8d64b4e2 key 'all', runs green under bin/cairn test --exec: the sieve returns no findings for component tester; Seal is a DiagnosticBase, raises dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError on field assignment, compares equal with equal hash by fields, and keeps sealed and trustworthy; Isolation and NoIsolation are DiagnosticBase subclasses, NoIsolation() constructs, its wrap returns the argv unchanged and available is True; and cairn.devices.tester.isolation imports in a fresh interpreter. Hollow: revert cairn/devices/tester/isolation.py to the pre-build commit and the sieve tooth and the is-a-DiagnosticBase teeth red. Wrong intent if inheriting the mixin changes any isolation class's observable behaviour. proven_by = cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_every_tester_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py.

decisions.text: D1: THE EDIT, ONE FILE. In cairn/devices/tester/isolation.py add the line 'from cairn.tools.base.diagnostic import DiagnosticBase' directly after the existing line 'from cairn.tools.base.address import ROOTS' (line 70). Change the line 'class Seal:' (line 137, under its unchanged '@dataclass(frozen=True)' decorator) to 'class Seal(DiagnosticBase):'. Change the line 'class Isolation(ABC):' (line 636) to 'class Isolation(DiagnosticBase, ABC):'. NoIsolation ('class NoIsolation(Isolation):', line 717) is not edited; it reaches the mixin through Isolation. No class body, field, method or __init__ changes. A frozen Seal's mixin setters raise FrozenInstanceError, loud, as base's Workflow does under e8b58520aeb9 D5; the emit path writes through __dict__, which a frozen dataclass permits.

D2: THE PROOF. Create cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_every_tester_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py, modelled on cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_every_base_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py (same check()/FAILURES/TEETH/main shape, _REPO = parents[4], every import of code under test inside its tooth). PROVES = {'668c8d64b4e2': {'all': 'test_the_tester_holds_every_clause_of_the_falsifier'}}. Teeth: (1) test_the_sieve_reads_the_tester_green: chdir to _REPO, inspector.every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin({'component': 'tester', 'dir': 'cairn/devices/tester'}, Path('cairn/devices/tester')) == []; (2) test_isolation_imports_fresh: subprocess 'import cairn.devices.tester.isolation' exits 0; (3) test_the_seal_stays_frozen_and_equal: importing SEALED, OPEN, INDETERMINATE and BREACHED from cairn.devices.tester.isolation (which re-exports them from cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py), Seal(SEALED, 'x') is a DiagnosticBase, equals Seal(SEALED, 'x') with equal hash, setattr(seal, 'verdict', OPEN) raises dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError, and for each of the four verdicts .sealed is (verdict == SEALED) and .trustworthy is (verdict in (SEALED, OPEN)); (4) test_the_isolations_reach_the_mixin_and_behave: issubclass(Isolation, DiagnosticBase) and issubclass(NoIsolation, DiagnosticBase), NoIsolation().wrap(['true'], '/') == ['true'] (no instance_swap), NoIsolation().available() == (True, 'always available'), and get_isolation('none') is a NoIsolation. The final tooth test_the_tester_holds_every_clause_of_the_falsifier is green only when every other tooth is. Run: bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_every_tester_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py', twice. Hollow: bin/cairn test --hollow 668c8d64b4e2 --proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_every_tester_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py.
